explanation: Improve the current best upper bound N^{1/2} + 0.94349N^{1/4} + O(1) (Hou–Zhao 2026) for infinitely many N, i.e. a bound with constant c < 0.94349. Green's original target (Lindström's bound) has already been beaten (BFR, CHO, HZ), so framing the open question relative to the latest bound is reasonable. The statement is well formed.
